task.title: Add an event of your own kind
task.shortdesc: Record something that has no word in the list of events, such as the publication of a book, by naming the kind yourself.

prereq.p: Open the page of Charlotte Brontë first. shows how.

context.p: The list has a word for many kinds of event. It has no choice named Event. The last choice is , a general word. When the list has no word for your kind, choose and name the kind yourself in the box . This page adds the publication of Poems by Currer, Ellis, and Acton Bell in May 1846 to the page of Charlotte Brontë.

step.cmd: Open the form for an event, as shows: choose , then , then .

info.p: It is at the end of the list.

step.cmd: In , type the name of the kind.
Under , turn on and type May 1846.

info.p: You do not need the day. Choose another box when you have typed the date, then read the line named How the date reads to check what the app understood. says more about typing a date as text.

step.cmd: In , type the title of the book.

info.p: For this event, type Poems by Currer, Ellis, and Acton Bell.

stepresult.p: Look for the new event in the list, and read its line to check it.

result.p: You have recorded an event of your own kind, with the kind named in your own words.
